lede: Wednesday's HARC meeting is the one to watch this week — the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave goes before the commission for three separate preliminary large-scale public hearings covering eight buildings on two lots in the Accommodations 2 zone, the kind of project that reshapes a neighborhood for generations. Tuesday's BOCC meeting isn't far behind, with Land Use Code amendments on natural medicine businesses and nonconforming lots both on the table. And on Thursday, the county holds its sixth working session on rewriting housing code to make workforce and affordable housing easier to build — that one's been quietly moving toward final recommendations.
